$about: Chile's wine zones, as Decreto 464 (1994, SAG's consolidated text) defines them: each by provinces, comunas or a whole administrative region. The atlas draws them from geoBoundaries (BCN comunas and regions, OpenStreetMap provinces), with today's provinces. Regions with no list here (Atacama, Coquimbo, Aconcagua, Central Valley, Southern Chile) join the valleys inside them. Alto, Central and Pacific Maipo are not in the decree, so they have no shape.

$source.name: Decreto 464, Zonificación vitícola y denominación de origen, Servicio Agrícola y Ganadero (consolidated text)
